agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
December 19, 2011
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: December 5, 2011
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report recommending acceptance of the work performed by Excel Paving Company for Phase 1A Water Main Replacement and Street Improvement Project, authorizing the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder's Office and authorizing the Director of Public Works to release the 10% retention payment in the amount of $135,841.76 to Excel Paving. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
e.
Report recommending acceptance of the work performed by Pavement Coatings Company for the citywide slurry seal project, authorizing the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder's Office and authorizing the Director of Public Works to release the 10% retention payment in the amount of $15,267.96 to Pavement Coatings Company. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
f.
Report submitting Amendment No. 2 to the Tree Maintenance Services Contract with West Coast Arborists, Inc. by extending it until June 30, 2015 with the same terms and conditions as in the last agreement. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
g.
Report recommending approval of proposal by West Coast Arborist to remove palm trees interfering with overhead utility lines on Narbonne Avenue between 256th Street and the northern city limit in the amount not to exceed $11,269.80. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
h.
Report recommending extension of agreement with Dickson Sweeping on a month to month basis with the same terms and conditions set forth in the contract amendment of November 1, 2010. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
i.
Report recommending authorizing the City Manager to execute agreements with participating local veterinarians to become partners for the City of Lomita Spay and Neuter Voucher Program. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
j.
Report recommending adoption of resolution and authorizing the Director of Public Works to execute and submit required documentation for a Cooperative Work Agreement through the California Department of Transportation for a one-year extension from June 30, 2012 to June 30, 2013 of the Safe Routes To School program funds. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
SCHEDULED MATTERS
5.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS Report recommending that appointments be made to vacancies on the Planning Commission, Railroad Museum Foundation Board and Parks and Recreation Commission.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
6.
COUNCIL ASSIGNMENTS Designation of Councilmember to serve on the Municipal Area Express and Joint Powers Insurance Authority.
Presented by City Manager Tomita
7.
MINIMUM LOT SIZE IN THE A-1 ZONE Discussion of zoning standards in the A-1 zone including but not limited to lot size. Requested by Councilmember Traina
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
